name: Parallax Image Columns
description: Full-bleed scroll-driven gallery: four image columns each translating upward at distinct parallax rates, producing a layered depth effect. A centered scroll-cue band sits above the image field.

columns.description: Image columns. At ≥48rem the section renders 4 columns of 8 images; below 48rem it renders 2 columns of 7. Caller-supplied entries replace defaults at that index; missing columns fall back to seeded picsum placeholders.

responsive.notes: At 48rem+ renders 4 columns × 8 images with parallax factors [1.0, 1.6, 0.6, 1.3]. Below 48rem switches to 2 columns × 7 images with factors [0.7, 1.2]. All factors held below the gallery height factor (1.75 = h-[175vh]) so columns are guaranteed to remain in view across the full scroll range — no end-of-content gaps at any viewport.

changelog.summary: Definitive no-gap fix. Image cells use aspect-[8/11] (matches picsum 800/1100 source — no crop) with shrink-0 so the flex column can no longer compress portraits into squashed landscape boxes. Offsets re-derived from the correct constraint (|X| ≥ factor / 1.75 — CSS top-percentage uses containing block height, not own height). Slot count is dynamic — computed on mount + resize from viewport so cells_natural_h ≥ gallery_h × (1 + |X|) at any size.

Responsive layout: 4 columns at ≥48rem / 2 columns at <48rem (was 4 always). Removed min-w-[200px] that overflowed mobile. Parallax factors retuned below the gallery height factor so the columns never run out of content during the scroll-scrub — gap-free at any viewport. Image count per column raised from 3 to 8 desktop / 7 mobile.

curation.intent: Scroll-driven parallax gallery with four independently translating image columns and a centered scroll-cue indicator above.
curation.structuralPattern: 4-column vertical image grid with differential scroll-rate parallax per column
